title: Memory v0 Preference Write/Search
description: Checks that Scarlet can autonomously write a stable project preference and later retrieve it through Memory v0. This is a regression floor, not a substitute for adaptive live evaluation.

turns.message: Scarlet, nota operativa stabile per il progetto: nei prossimi SAL preferisco tre blocchi in ordine, cosa e cambiato, verifica eseguita, rischi e prossimo passo. Rispondi in modo naturale e usa le tue funzioni cognitive se lo ritieni rilevante.

expectations.label: turn persisted a memory write trace

turns.notes: The prompt does not ask for permission-gated saving; the model should decide that a stable preference is reusable.

turns.message: Scarlet, quale formato preferisco per i SAL di progetto? Usa memoria persistente se serve e indica la fonte.

expectations.label: turn persisted a memory search trace
answer attributes source to persistent memory

turns.notes: The same scenario session still has chat history, so the trace expectation is the important check.

review_questions: Did Scarlet decide to write memory without asking for save permission?
Did the later answer use memory search rather than relying only on chat history?
Did the answer distinguish persistent memory from current chat context?
Were write/search traces and tool-call traces easy to inspect in order?
